# Rubic API-v2 direct-route fixtures

| File | Provenance and use |
| --- | --- |
| `chains_v2.json` | Public keyless `/api/info/chains?includeTestnets=false` discovery on 2026-10-07. All 101 source rows, nullable provider numbers, family labels and nested provider lists remain source declarations. |
| `quote_best_v2.json`, `quote_all_v2.json` | Public native ETH→native POL, gross input 0.01 ETH, 100 bps slippage, explicit `notDeposits` and `notPrivate`. Caller gross, source fee-adjusted input and each leg amount differ legitimately. All six returned route selections are retained. |
| `swap_v2.json` | Public direct `/api/routes/swap` discovery for the selected LI.FI route and documented public sender/receiver. Exact unsigned EVM fields, recalculated estimate and source-expanded integrator/blacklists are retained. |
| `quote_best_squid_v2.json`, `swap_squid_v2.json` | Public direct quote/build discovery with explicit Squid preference. Captures `uniqueInfo.additionalData` as an object alongside the deprecated string `squidrouterRequestId`; this is a regression for an actual Rust preparation decode failure. |
| `swap_without_tokens_v2.json` | Contract mutation of the captured Squid swap, removing `tokens`. Maintained `SwapResponseInterface` does not require these fields; missing fresh metadata stays unavailable rather than being copied from the original quote. This file is not an unchanged live capture. |
| `quote_best_solana_v2.json` | Public wrapped SOL→native POL quote with exact 0.1 SOL-unit input. Input mint ends in `112`; source native fee sentinel ends in `111`. Actual two on-chain legs and implicit cross-chain continuation remain distinct source facts. |
| `status_v2.json` | Actual `statusExtended` lookup for a non-executed route ID and documented public transaction hash, returning `NOT_FOUND`. No funded route or destination execution is claimed. |
| `quote_domain.json`, `prepared_domain.json` | Exact typed conversions of the first EVM source captures, with explicit caller-qualified ETH/Polygon catalogue and preparation constraints. Numeric conversion used decimal arithmetic, without binary floating point. |
| `live_inputs.json` | Explicit public API, provider label, descriptive User-Agent, caller catalogue, gross amount/slippage, sender/receiver, router, caller floor/value ceiling and handoff correlation ID. No API key, signer or submission input exists. |

| Primary reference | Checked contract |
| --- | --- |
| [Current public Swagger](https://api-v2.rubic.exchange/api/swagger/swagger-ui-init.js) | Current API-v2 catalogue, direct quote/build, source estimate/fees and extended status shape. |
| [Access and referrer](https://docs.rubic.finance/api-docs/about/referrer) | Public keyless ten requests/minute and separately optional `apikey` access. |
| [All available quotes](https://docs.rubic.finance/api-reference/router/get-all-available-quotes) | Source-selected bounded routes, explicit amounts/slippage and provider filters. |
| [Unsigned swap data](https://docs.rubic.finance/api-reference/router/get-swap-data) | Selected route ID and explicit sender/receiver; returned unsigned data does not perform execution. |
| [Amount change](https://docs.rubic.finance/api-docs/guides/handling-amount-change) | Preparation recalculates amounts. Earlier quote facts, fresh facts and the caller's explicit output floor remain separate review inputs. |
| [Extended status](https://docs.rubic.finance/api-reference/info/get-transaction-status), [status meanings](https://docs.rubic.finance/api-docs/general/status/explain) | Literal source progress and optional destination facts; `NOT_FOUND` does not prove a consensus rejection and `SUCCESS` is provider progress, not chain finality. |
| [Pinned official app API source](https://github.com/Cryptorubic/rubic-app/blob/89a6bb9d6c68fa3a4a421428e2e5e5ce21f36aee/src/app/core/services/sdk/sdk-legacy/rubic-api/rubic-api.service.ts) | Direct `/quoteAll`, `/quoteBest`, `/swap` separated from deposit-order creation. Current status query uses `rubicId` plus the decentralized source transaction hash. |
| [Released core 1.9.1](https://registry.npmjs.org/@cryptorubic/core/1.9.1) | `ProviderTag[]`, native-SOL provider sentinel, direct swap request and provider-specific `additionalData?: {[key:string]:unknown}`. This package was inspected as primary evidence; it is not a Rust dependency. |

Context7 was checked against the current primary docs and exact maintained app/core source. Cached legacy `/info/status` examples are superseded by the current `statusExtended` contract. Current Swagger's scalar `providerTags` conflicts with both actual server validation and core 1.9.1's array type; the backend sends an explicit array. The public endpoint rejected discovery's default urllib User-Agent with Cloudflare 1010, then accepted the explicit descriptive caller header in `live_inputs.json`. No header is silently added by this backend.

Current Swagger's `StatusResponseDto` and the [official app's status model](https://github.com/Cryptorubic/rubic-app/blob/89a6bb9d6c68fa3a4a421428e2e5e5ce21f36aee/src/app/core/services/sdk/sdk-legacy/features/ws-api/models/cross-chain-tx-status-config.ts) do not require `rubicId` or `sourceTxHash` response echoes. The captured `NOT_FOUND` response supplies both; these original bytes are unchanged. Contract tests also cover `SUCCESS` with absent/null echoes or either echo independently present. Every supplied identity must match the caller query; unavailable echoes leave the response attributed to that exact query without claiming an echoed identity or chain inclusion. The EVM native-call value ceiling does not verify spending by Solana instructions.

The ignored `rubic_live` harness accepts the complete file text in `REGIT_WEB3_RUBIC_INPUTS_JSON`, paces independent calls by 6.2 seconds, and exercises all five Rust methods, exact typed serde roundtrips and local review/handoff. Provider alias/ID comparison does not verify genesis. EVM fields omit nonce/fees until separately supplied. Solana payloads use maintained canonical message/transaction codecs with zero signature placeholders; recent blockhash bytes do not supply a last-valid block height. The loopback Solana unsigned payload is a harmless transfer codec vector used only to test the adapter, not proof that a source swap matches reviewed intent. Concrete semantic verification and signing remain caller-owned. No deposit/private order, relay or funded submission is performed.
